recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Reapplying the old 2015 past-only patient wording would contradict later published Patient Care decisions; any future Procedure definition change should come from a new WG decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care request to change Procedure's definition from present tense to a past-tense summary: "A summary description of an action performed on a patient".
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-5828 source commit was found. The likely untagged SVN-import application is 07aa93633f, shortly after the vote, which changed Procedure root wording from present-only to "was or is currently being"/"is or was" and added narrative that Procedure provides summary information rather than real-time snapshots.
additional_context: Later Published Patient Care decisions changed the target wording: FHIR-15127 broadened Procedure for services performed on or for a patient while retaining "is or was" wording, and FHIR-26859 expanded Procedure.subject and the root definition to patient, practitioner, device, organization, or location.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current Procedure source already states an action that is or was performed and its narrative covers current and historical summary use without trying to provide real-time execution detail.
source_changes: No source changes; empty audit commit only.

related_jiras.note: Published STU3 decision that broadened Procedure for long-term services performed on or for a patient while preserving the is-or-was wording.
Published R5 decision that expanded Procedure.subject and the root definition to non-patient subjects, superseding the patient-only part of the DSTU1 wording.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to make the Procedure definition past-tense: a summary description of an action performed on a patient.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the original approved DSTU1 request and its non-substantive correction scope.

evidence_items.summary: Procedure is active in fhir.ini and current source defines an action that is or was performed, with narrative for current and historical summary use.
evidence_items.learned: The built source already captures the performed-summary concept while reflecting later current/in-progress Procedure scope.

evidence_items.summary: 2015 untagged Procedure update changed present-only root wording to was/is-currently-being and is/was wording and added summary-not-real-time narrative.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-5828's tense concern appears to have been applied historically even though the exact resolution sentence was not retained.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 decision to update Procedure scope for long-term services performed on or for a patient, explicitly using an is-or-was definition.
evidence_items.learned: Later formal Patient Care intent retained current and historical Procedure scope, so past-only wording should not be restored.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 decision expanded Procedure.subject and the root definition to patient, practitioner, device, organization, or location.
evidence_items.learned: The current non-patient Procedure wording is a later approved change that supersedes the patient-only DSTU1 formulation.

evidence_items.summary: Later Procedure commits implemented FHIR-15127 and FHIR-26859 scope changes in the same active Procedure source family.
evidence_items.learned: Git history aligns current source with later Jira decisions and explains why exact FHIR-5828 wording is no longer the target.
